integrity: The proof is elementary and self-contained apart from standard lifting-the-exponent and Chinese remainder facts. Finite checks supplement but do not establish the universal statements. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Odd n>1 and base 2 only. The proof does not solve the classification of Wieferich primes, optimize global asymptotics, or replace prime factorization and multiplicative-order computation. Earlier implicit priority is possible, especially Franco--Pomerance (1995), whose full text was not available.
title: Exact local defects and prime-support thresholds for non-Wieferich integers
